customFields.title: Custom Fields

vehicles.title: Customer Vehicles
vehicles.pageDescription: Manage the portfolio of customer vehicles serviced or supplied with parts by your business.
vehicles.infoBanner: Customer vehicle portfolio is currently in view-only mode. Adding and deleting vehicles will be activated upon completion of corporate authorization (Policy A) integration.
vehicles.searchPlaceholder: Search by plate, VIN, make, model or customer note...
vehicles.noVehiclesFound: No customer vehicles found matching your search.
vehicles.searchTip: You can try searching with a different plate or VIN number.
vehicles.emptyTip: Use the 'Add New Customer Vehicle' button to add vehicles you service or sell parts for.
vehicles.deleteDisabledTitle: Only business owners or administrators can delete vehicle records.
vehicles.modalDescription: Enter details of the vehicle belonging to the customer your business serves. Plate or VIN is required.
vehicles.plateHint: Turkish letters, numbers, spaces, and hyphens supported.
vehicles.vinHint: Official vehicle chassis number. Letters, digits, periods, and hyphens allowed.
vehicles.deletePrompt: Are you sure you want to delete customer vehicle with identifier {{identifier}}?
vehicles.deleteWarning: This removes the vehicle from the active list. Historical quotes and service audit logs remain safely preserved for data integrity.
vehicles.errorSessionExpired: Session expired or organization access unauthorized.
vehicles.errorOrgFetchFailed: Failed to retrieve organization info. Please refresh the page.
vehicles.errorOrgConnection: Connection error: Failed to retrieve organization info.
vehicles.errorForbidden: You do not have permission to view customer vehicles for this organization.
vehicles.errorVehicleFetchFailed: Failed to load customer vehicle list. Please try again.
vehicles.errorVehicleConnection: Connection error: Failed to load customer vehicles.
vehicles.errorServiceUnavailable: Vehicle registration operations are temporarily disabled until authorization integration is complete.
vehicles.errorDuplicate: This plate or VIN is already registered for this business.
vehicles.errorActionForbidden: You do not have permission for this action.
vehicles.errorSaveFailed: Failed to save vehicle. Please check the fields.
vehicles.errorSaveConnection: Connection error: Failed to save vehicle.
vehicles.errorDeleteUnavailable: Vehicle deletion operations are temporarily disabled until authorization integration is complete.
vehicles.errorDeleteForbidden: Vehicle deletion permission belongs only to business owners or administrators.
vehicles.errorDeleteFailed: Failed to delete customer vehicle. Please try again.
vehicles.errorDeleteConnection: Connection error: Failed to delete vehicle.

validation.plateOrVinRequired: At least one identifier (Plate or VIN) must be entered.
validation.plateMaxLength: Plate can be at most 64 characters.
validation.plateInvalidChars: Plate can only contain letters, numbers, spaces, and hyphens.
validation.vinMaxLength: VIN can be at most 128 characters.
validation.vinInvalidChars: VIN can only contain letters, numbers, periods, slashes, and hyphens.
validation.makeMaxLength: Make can be at most 100 characters.
validation.modelMaxLength: Model can be at most 100 characters.
validation.labelMaxLength: Customer note / label can be at most 100 characters.
validation.modelYearInvalid: Model year must be a valid integer between 1886 and 2100.
